contexts.text: That those evils and falsities against which the Lord fought did not appear sooner than in childhood, and that then they burst forth, is signified by the kings serving Chedorlaomer ().
Chedorlaomer etc. () = so many kinds of apparent goods and truths, which in themselves are not goods and truths, in the Lord's external man. AC 1667.

Twelve years they served Chedorlaomer () = that evils and falsities did not appear during childhood, but that they served apparent goods and truths... Chedorlaomer in the complex stands for all the kings who are mentioned in .
Such good and truth as there is with a child before he is instructed is signified by Chedorlaomer.
Came Chedorlaomer () = the apparent good in the external man... Chedorlaomer here = only good, because it is added and the kings who were with him. AC 1672:end.

By Chedorlaomer is represented the Lord's good and truth during childhood, thus the Lord's human essence as to good and truth at that time, by which He destroyed the persuasions of falsity, that is, the Hells filled with such a devil's crew, who by persuasions of what is false attempted to destroy the World of Spirits, and consequently the human race.

The reason Chedorlaomer king of Elam here = truths, and Tidal king of Goiim = goods, is that these kings are here mentioned in a different order; here Chedorlaomer is mentioned first, before, he is mentioned fourth...
By Chedorlaomer and the kings with him are signified the goods and truths of the exterior man.
After he had returned from smiting Chedorlaomer and the kings who were with him () = the deliverance and the vindication of apparent goods and truths.
